scope: Bounded source research and real image inspection only. No generation, no asset publication, no repository status changes.

results.summary: The new Archives image has visible margins around both wings, body and feet, but visually reproduces the held catalogue pose and distal wing contour. It supplies no independent missing wing-tip anatomy. The original catalogue download is byte-identical to the R34 retained reference.
results.important_discrepancy: The old receipt describes a wing exiting the upper frame. In the downloaded raster the outer silhouette is inset from the image edge; the concern is the already truncated-looking distal contour, not a newly discovered larger original canvas. Neither simple re-framing nor re-inspecting identical bytes is counted as new anatomy.

r34_receipt.exact_reason: One raised wing exits the upper frame. Its complete wing tip/span is not established by the retained image.

results.summary: A white/grey full-body model view was found, including feet, but it belongs to an edited Left 4 Dead 2 port. The source credits Resident Evil 0 without distinguishing 2002 original from HD Remaster, and explicitly credits rigging/editing. It is useful supplementary anatomy, not a verified native original reference.

observations: White/grey fur, black face, large open mouth and fangs, red exposed shoulder/arm tissue.
limitations: Lower legs and feet are outside the frame.
Cannot establish full original variant geometry.
